prompt: I cannot cook this roast unless I (to find) a bigger dish.
explanation_ru: После союза unless («если не») в придаточном условия используется Present Simple (find), а не will, и дополнительное отрицание не нужно.

prompt: Guests get free breakfast ___ they book their room directly.
explanation_ru: Союз only if задаёт единственное условие («только если»). Частая ошибка — путать его с even if («даже если») или unless («если не»).

prompt: Seojun will join the science fair as long as his test (to work).
explanation_ru: После союза as long as («при условии, что») для будущего условия ставится Present Simple (works), а не will.

prompt: Take a warm jacket on the hill walk ___ it gets cold.
explanation_ru: Союз in case выражает меру предосторожности («на случай, если»), а не строгое условие. Остальные союзы искажают смысл.

prompt: You may not enter the greenhouse unless you do not have a guide.
answer: You may not enter the greenhouse unless you have a guide.
accepted_answers: You may not enter the greenhouse unless you have a guide.
You may not enter the greenhouse if you do not have a guide.
You may not enter the greenhouse if you don't have a guide.
explanation_ru: Союз unless уже содержит отрицание («если не»), поэтому глагол после него ставится в утвердительной форме. Двойное отрицание unless ... do not — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Jacek will not try the pizza bar ___ his friend comes too.
explanation_ru: Здесь нужно значение «если не» (unless): без друга Яцек не пойдёт. Союз as long as дал бы обратный смысл.

prompt: You can light a fire here if the wind is not strong. → You can light a fire here as long as …
answer: You can light a fire here as long as the wind is not strong.
accepted_answers: You can light a fire here as long as the wind is not strong.
You can light a fire here as long as the wind isn't strong.
explanation_ru: Союз as long as («при условии, что») заменяет if в значении строгого правила, сохраняя Present Simple в придаточном.

prompt: "Can we stay two more nights?" "Yes, provided a sea-view room (to become) free in the morning."
explanation_ru: После союза provided («при условии, что») для будущего условия используется Present Simple (becomes), а не форма с will.

prompt: Victoria plans to book tickets for the portrait show, ___ her friend confirms by Friday.
explanation_ru: Союз providing that вводит необходимое условие («при условии, что»). Типичная ошибка — ставить in case of перед целым придаточным или путать условие с even if.

prompt: Visitors can keep their phones during the planetarium show as long as the screens will stay off.
answer: Visitors can keep their phones during the planetarium show as long as the screens stay off.
accepted_answers: Visitors can keep their phones during the planetarium show as long as the screens stay off.
explanation_ru: После условного союза as long as нельзя употреблять will — для будущего условия нужен Present Simple (stay).

prompt: We have agreed to order fifty extra toy trains ___ the supplier confirms the lower price. We cannot place the order ___ they send a written quote first. Keep our backup supplier's phone number on the desk ___ this deal falls through. We have to open the winter sale on Saturday anyway, ___ the extra trains arrive late.
explanation_ru: В тексте разграничиваются четыре значения: условие (as long as), исключение «если не» (unless), предосторожность (in case) и уступка «даже если» (even if).

prompt: I will work the late taxi shift tonight if it does not snow heavily. → I will work the late taxi shift tonight unless …
answer: I will work the late taxi shift tonight unless it snows heavily.
accepted_answers: I will work the late taxi shift tonight unless it snows heavily.
I'll work the late taxi shift tonight unless it snows heavily.
explanation_ru: Заменяя if ... does not на unless, нужно убрать отрицание и вернуть глаголу окончание -s в Present Simple (snows).

prompt: Krzysztof will accept the shop job on condition that the manager (to agree) to his start date.
explanation_ru: После союза on condition that («при условии, что») в придаточном условия ставится Present Simple (agrees), а не будущее время.

prompt: Amara wants to cycle to the market in Lagos, but her back tyre is slowly losing air. She will not reach the stalls on time unless she (to fix) it first. "Suppose the tyre (to go) flat halfway down the road — how would I get these bags home?" she thinks. Even if the repair (not / to take) long, she still puts bus fare in her pocket.
explanation_ru: После unless и even if в реальных ситуациях используется Present Simple (fixes; does not take), а после suppose в паре с would для воображаемой ситуации нужен Past Simple (went).

prompt: Mio is a lifeguard in Essaouira. He lets the young swimmers enter the water, with one rule: they must stay in the shallow part while the waves are high.
options: "You can swim here even if you stay in the shallow water."
"You can swim here unless you stay in the shallow water."
"You can swim here as long as you stay in the shallow water."
"You can swim here in case you stay in the shallow water."
explanation_ru: Разрешение с обязательным условием передаёт союз as long as («при условии, что»). Союз unless перевернул бы правило наоборот.

prompt: "I'll cover the weekend deliveries, Hugo, so long as you (to handle) the early morning shifts."
explanation_ru: После so long as (вариант as long as) для будущего условия употребляется Present Simple (handle), без will.

prompt: Sven leaves spare washing-up liquid under the sink in case anyone runs out after cooking dinner.
answer: Sven leaves spare washing-up liquid under the sink in case anyone runs out after cooking dinner.
accepted_answers: Sven leaves spare washing-up liquid under the sink in case anyone runs out after cooking dinner.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после союза in case («на случай, если») правильно употреблён Present Simple (runs out) без will.

prompt: Students may practise on the grand piano if they book a tuner each month. → Students may practise on the grand piano provided …
answer: Students may practise on the grand piano provided they book a tuner each month.
accepted_answers: Students may practise on the grand piano provided they book a tuner each month.
Students may practise on the grand piano provided that they book a tuner each month.
explanation_ru: Союз provided (that) вводит официальное условие вместо if, а глагол после него остаётся в Present Simple (book).

prompt: Photography is permitted inside the Pamplona gallery ___ you switch off your camera flash.
explanation_ru: Правило разрешает съёмку при одном обязательном условии — only if. Частая ошибка — выбирать even if или unless.

prompt: Whoever arrives late to orchestra rehearsal has to make tea for everyone, ___ they have an excuse or not.
explanation_ru: В значении «независимо от того, ... или нет» используется конструкция whether ... or not, а не if.

prompt: Suppose my bean seeds (not / to grow) in time for the fair — what will I show the judges?
explanation_ru: Во второй части стоит will (реальное возможное будущее), поэтому после suppose нужен Present Simple (do not grow / don't grow).

prompt: Maeve has agreed to mind her neighbour's stall at noon ___ she gets her own lunch break afterwards. She keeps checking the clock because she will not get a break ___ her neighbour comes back soon. She also brought a plastic cover for the books ___ it starts to rain. They will pack up the stall at five, ___ they sell everything or not.
explanation_ru: Здесь сочетаются условие сделки (as long as), исключение «если не» (unless), мера предосторожности (in case) и пара whether ... or not.

prompt: The start-up founder in Shannon wants to launch the app in spring, but she will delay it if the test group gives weak feedback.
options: The founder will launch the app in spring unless the test group gives weak feedback.
The founder will launch the app in spring unless the test group does not give weak feedback.
The founder will launch the app in spring even if the test group gives weak feedback.
The founder will launch the app in spring in case the test group gives weak feedback.
explanation_ru: Союз unless заменяет «если не» без дополнительного отрицания: запуск состоится весной, если только отзывы не окажутся слабыми.

prompt: "Excuse me, can I rent a scooter with my bicycle helmet?" Tomasz asks in Warsaw. "You can ride off today provided the strap (to fasten) safely," the shop assistant says. "Take this phone number too in case you (to have) a flat tyre in town." "Good idea — even if I (not / to plan) to go far, it is better to be ready."
explanation_ru: После союзов provided, in case и even if для реальных и возможных ситуаций используется Present Simple (fastens, have, do not plan), а не will.

prompt: Emi's travel agency can advertise the summer island tour ___ the ferry company confirms the timetable this week. The printer is waiting, because Emi cannot approve the brochures ___ those sailing dates are final. She is keeping a train route ready ___ the ferry company cancels the extra boats. Either way, she will email all her regular clients on Friday, ___ the tour goes ahead or not.
explanation_ru: Союз provided задаёт условие рекламы тура, unless — причину задержки печати, in case — запасной план, а whether идёт в паре с or not.

prompt: Only if the starting salary (to cover) his daily train fare will Kaito sign the Mannheim contract, so he is keeping a backup offer open in case the talks (to fail).
explanation_ru: И после only if, и после in case при отсылке к возможному будущему используется Present Simple (covers; fail), без вспомогательного will.

prompt: Fang has promised to prepare the revision notes for her Perugia study group by Thursday, ___ the rest of the flatmates manage to agree on a meeting time or not.
explanation_ru: С конструкцией «... or not» в значении «независимо от того, ... или нет» грамматически сочетается только союз whether.

prompt: Ruairi will agree to move the weekly team meeting in Poznań to Friday only if the new call software arrives before lunch. → Only if the new call software arrives before lunch …
answer: Only if the new call software arrives before lunch will Ruairi agree to move the weekly team meeting in Poznań to Friday.
accepted_answers: Only if the new call software arrives before lunch will Ruairi agree to move the weekly team meeting in Poznań to Friday.
explanation_ru: Когда придаточное с only if выносится в начало предложения, в главном предложении обязательна инверсия (will Ruairi agree).

prompt: Donghyun has asked the shop in Reading to hold a new laptop from the sale in case the technician will call to say his old one cannot be repaired.
answer: Donghyun has asked the shop in Reading to hold a new laptop from the sale in case the technician calls to say his old one cannot be repaired.
accepted_answers: Donghyun has asked the shop in Reading to hold a new laptop from the sale in case the technician calls to say his old one cannot be repaired.
explanation_ru: После союза in case («на случай, если») не употребляется will — для возможного события в будущем ставится Present Simple (calls).

prompt: Rune's wife supports his plan to cycle to work ___ he wears a bright helmet on the main road. He will keep taking the bus ___ the bike shop delivers that helmet before Monday. He has also packed a light raincoat and spare batteries ___ the weather turns wet on his way home. Once the helmet is here, he intends to cycle anyway, ___ the morning air feels freezing. He will set off twenty minutes early on his first ride, ___ the cycle lane is busy or quiet.
explanation_ru: Каждая связка отвечает за свой смысл: строгое условие (on condition that), «если не» (unless), предосторожность (in case), уступка (even if) и выбор «ли ... или» (whether).

prompt: Lakshmi is desperate to attend her cousin's wedding in Goa, and she has already warned her manager that she will go by night train even without paid leave.
options: Lakshmi will travel to Goa only if her manager refuses to approve her paid leave.
Lakshmi will travel to Goa even if her manager refuses to approve her paid leave.
Lakshmi will travel to Goa unless her manager refuses to approve her paid leave.
Lakshmi will travel to Goa in case her manager refuses to approve her paid leave.
explanation_ru: Поездка состоится вопреки отказу, поэтому нужен союз even if («даже если»). Союз unless означал бы, что при отказе она останется дома.

prompt: Charlie is worried about Leuven: ___ his final maths grades turned out lower than expected, would the engineering department still consider his application?
explanation_ru: Союз supposing («предположим») вводит гипотетический вопрос с Past Simple и would. Союзы unless, in case и as long as не подходят по смыслу.

prompt: At our sports shop in Xi'an, whoever sells the last display bike gets the weekend off providing the buyer (to pay) full price, even if the deal (to happen) five minutes before closing.
explanation_ru: Обе части описывают действующее правило магазина, поэтому после providing и even if требуется Present Simple (pays; happens).

prompt: Our editor in Hsinchu will let you publish the weekend update if you also reply to the first ten comments. → Our editor in Hsinchu will let you publish the weekend update on condition that …
answer: Our editor in Hsinchu will let you publish the weekend update on condition that you also reply to the first ten comments.
accepted_answers: Our editor in Hsinchu will let you publish the weekend update on condition that you also reply to the first ten comments.
explanation_ru: Союз on condition that («при условии, что») заменяет if для формальной договорённости, сохраняя Present Simple (reply) в придаточном.

prompt: Karen shares a tiny tutor office in Riga where the window desk is the only spot with decent light. "The deal is simple: you get the window seat as long as you (to unlock) the office before nine," she jokes over coffee. "Even if the morning bus (not / to get) stuck by the bridge, I still live twice as far away as you," he replies. "All right, suppose we (to swap) desks each Monday — would that feel fairer?"
explanation_ru: После as long as и even if для обычных правил и фактов используется Present Simple (unlock; does not get), а после suppose в воображаемом предложении с would — Past Simple (swapped).

prompt: In Ivaylo's house in Plovdiv, anyone is allowed to feed the family parrot ___ they also clean the bottom of its cage. Because wiping the tray takes ten minutes, Ivaylo never feeds the bird before school ___ he wakes up early. His mother keeps a roll of paper towels beside the cage ___ the parrot tips its water bowl over. Still, the clever bird copies the sound of the doorbell anyway, ___ nobody is waiting at the front gate. Everyone has to listen to its loud whistling at seven in the morning, ___ they want to sleep longer or not.
explanation_ru: В тексте различаются условие правила (providing that), исключение «если не» (unless), предосторожность (in case), уступка (even if) и конструкция whether ... or not.
